servicesSub: The kinds of jobs Clint's customers have booked him for.

services.title: TV mounting
services.short: TVs mounted exactly where you want them.

reviews.text: Clint did an absolutely outstanding job on a TV mount installation at a fraction of the price quoted by other local businesses. He was incredibly patient and careful in his placement.

Clint is an amazing handyman. He is professional, hard working and honest. Cat door install, hanging various items, resashing blinds, replace silicone on my shower tiles. Every job completed to an excellent standard.

Clint put together a garden shed including the cement slab for my Mum. He was very professional, a great communicator, arrived when he said he would and did a fabulous job. He is honest, polite and trustworthy.
Clint's energy and work ethic are infectious. He is incredibly knowledgeable on a wide range of trades and techniques.
